name: Alt: the UPLIFT L-desk on the left wall for the four screens, MITTZON job desk on the right, no guest bed
notes:
Alternative for Andrew's UPLIFT link (2026-10-24: "add standing desks for consideration for the office, this is large but try to accommodate something like this"), meeting F-62. The usable floor is the 106 x 106 square as in a: furniture from y 12 and upholstery from y 18 off the hatched heater wall (F-33, heater-depth-assumed), nothing below y 116 in front of the wardrobe or below y 122 in front of the door (F-31: the 36" landings, assumed-position:closet and assumed-position:door).
desk-l UPLIFT L-desk 80"Mx60"R, walnut laminate, electric sit/stand (22.6-50.9"): rot 270, the main along the left wall (x 0-30, y 30-110), the return at its south end (x 30-60, y 82.5-110), on the user's left as configured. The personal station: four 32" screens, three across the main on the HUANUO arms (the outer two angled in about 30 degrees, about 77") and the fourth on the return; all of them face away from the window or across it, never toward it. F-38: it starts 30" below the window wall, so nothing stands in front of the window; F-31: its south end 6" above the wardrobe's landing; F-35: 44.5" from the main's front to the job desk · fits.
chair-1 FLINTAN: in the L's corner, x 31-59, y 52-80, facing the main; it swivels left to the return. chair-2 FLINTAN: the job desk's, x 46.5-74.5, y 22-50, 16" from the heater wall; the two chairs sit 2" apart in y, so both stations work at once · fits.
desk-1 MITTZON 55 1/8x31 1/2, electric sit/stand: right wall, rot 90, x 74.5-106, y 12-67.1, the separate job station: the laptop on the ELLOVEN beside one 32" monitor, with room to spare (F-62); F-33 6" from the heater face · fits.
storage-2 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors 47 1/4" (top): hung above the job desk on two suspension rails, underside about 70" up, as in c (F-63).
The right wall's lower half stays open as the way in from the door: 46" between the return's end and the wall (F-30), then the 44.5" aisle between the two desks.
lamp-1 TÅGARP: bottom-left corner, left of the wardrobe's landing. plant-1 FEJKA: top-left corner, left of the window and above the L's north end.
rug-1 LOHALS (rug): x 30-82, y 22-99, under both chairs. rug-2 KOLON (rug): x 31-70.4, y 40-87.25, the chair mat under chair-1 and the foot of chair-2.
lamp-2 RÖDFLIK (top): on the L's return. lamp-3 RÖDFLIK (top): on the job desk's front corner. art-1 PJÄTTERYD (top): right wall above the way in, y 80-102.
No guest bed: opened, the chair bed would run into the L's return (at best 2.3" short whichever way the room is arranged), so this variant trades the guest bed for the L, as c does. No BESTÅ on the floor either: the only free wall is the way in from the door.

placements.note: UPLIFT L-desk: the main along the left wall (x 0-30, y 30-110), the return at its south end (x 30-60, y 82.5-110); four 32" screens, three across the main and one on the return (F-62); 30" below the window wall (F-38); 6" above the wardrobe's landing (F-31, assumed-position:closet)
FLINTAN in the L's corner, facing the main; swivels left to the return
MITTZON 55 1/8, the job station: laptop on the ELLOVEN and one 32" monitor (F-62); 6" from the heater face (F-33, heater-depth-assumed)
FLINTAN at the job desk, 16" from the heater wall (F-33); 2" above chair-1
BESTÅ cabinet hung above the job desk, underside about 70" up, two suspension rails (F-63)
TÅGARP uplighter in the bottom-left corner, left of the wardrobe's landing (assumed-position:closet)
FEJKA in the top-left corner, left of the window and above the L's north end
KOLON chair mat under chair-1 and the foot of chair-2
RÖDFLIK on the job desk's front corner
PJÄTTERYD on the right wall above the way in from the door

extras.note: HOPPVALS cordless cellular blinds, two side by side (68") over the 67" window; no floor-length curtains on the heater wall (F-33); check inside or outside mount (assumed-position:window)
HUANUO dual monitor arms for the four 32" screens on the L: three across the main, the fourth on the return (no-dimensions, so an extra)
FÖRSÄSONG cable tray under the MITTZON job desk; the UPLIFT comes with its own FlexMount cable manager and 10 cable wraps
FREIVID anti-fatigue mat, gray-green: for standing at the L (F-62)
ELLOVEN stand with drawer on the job desk: raises the job laptop beside the 32" monitor
BESTÅ suspension rails for the wall-hung cabinet, fixed into studs
